description:
This process begins when a customer searches for a flight, train, or bus ticket.
After selecting the preferred route, date, and time, the customer provides personal information and payment details.
The booking system generates a ticket, which is sent to the customer via email or SMS.
The travel company updates its seat inventory accordingly.
Before travel, the customer may receive reminders and instructions for check-in or boarding.
The process concludes once the customer completes their journey, though post-travel feedback or services may extend it slightly.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_TicketBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Search" name="Ticket search request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RouteSelected" name="Route, date and time selected"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Details" name="Personal and payment details provided"/>

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Reminder" name="Reminder and check-in or boarding instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Post-travel feedback or services"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Search" name="Ticket search" sourceRef="Task_SearchTicket" targetRef="StartEvent_SearchReceived" messageRef="Msg_Search"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Details" name="Personal and payment details" sourceRef="Task_ProvideDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDetails" messageRef="Msg_Details"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Ticket" name="Ticket" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" messageRef="Msg_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Reminder" name="Reminder and instructions" sourceRef="Task_SendReminders" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReminders" messageRef="Msg_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Feedback" name="Post-travel feedback or services" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer Ticket Booking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CustomerNeedsTicket" name="Ticket needed"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SearchTicket" name="Search for flight, train or bus ticket"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideDetails" name="Provide personal information and payment details"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTicket" name="Receive ticket by email or SMS" messageRef="Msg_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveReminders" name="Receive reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Customer_Feedback" name="Feedback or services used?" default="SF_C_NoFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide post-travel feedback or services"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FeedbackProvided" name="Feedback or services provided"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomerNeedsTicket" targetRef="Task_SearchTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C_02" sourceRef="Task_SearchTicket" targetRef="Task_SelectRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C_03" sourceRef="Task_SelectRoute" targetRef="Task_ProvideDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C_04" sourceRef="Task_ProvideDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C_05" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReminders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C_06" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveReminders" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C_07" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_Customer_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C_Feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_Customer_Feedback" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${feedbackOrServicesProvided}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C_NoFeedback" sourceRef="Gateway_Customer_Feedback" targetRef="EndEvent_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C_08" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="EndEvent_FeedbackProvided"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company Ticket Booking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SearchReceived" name="Ticket search received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Search" messageRef="Msg_Search"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowOptions" name="Show flight, train and bus options"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRouteSelection" name="Receive route, date and time selection" messageRef="Msg_RouteSelected"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDetails" name="Receive personal and payment details" messageRef="Msg_Details"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Ticket_Split" name="Split after ticket generation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicket" name="Send ticket via email or SMS" messageRef="Msg_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Ticket_Join" name="Join after ticket and inventory update"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReminders" name="Send reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Split" name="Feedback or services requested?" default="SF_T_NoFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive post-travel feedback or services" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FeedbackReceived" name="Feedback or services received"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Concluded" name="Booking concluded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_SearchReceived" targetRef="Task_ShowOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T_02" sourceRef="Task_ShowOptions" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRouteSelection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRouteSelection" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDetails" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T_05" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_Ticket_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T_06" sourceRef="Gateway_Ticket_Split" targetRef="Task_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T_07" sourceRef="Gateway_Ticket_Split" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T_08" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Gateway_Ticket_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T_09" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Ticket_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T_10" sourceRef="Gateway_Ticket_Join" targetRef="Task_SendReminders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T_11" sourceRef="Task_SendReminders" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T_Feedback" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${feedbackOrServicesRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T_NoFeedback" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_T_12" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="EndEvent_FeedbackReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
